 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Satya Prakash Sinha  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ramesh Chandra  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 22-05-2023 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
Let the defect(s), if any, be removed within a period of four weeks from today.

The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Goraul P.S. Case No. 77 of 2023 registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 420, 467, 468 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 30(a) of Bihar Prohibition and Excise Amendment Act.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 27.02.2023 and it is alleged that there is recovery of 711 liters of India made foreign liquor.
The petitioner is a person with clean antecedent.
Learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.32522 of 2023(2) dt.22-05-2023
Considering the period of custody and the allegations levelled against the petitioner, this application for regular bail is allowed.

Let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousands Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Rohit vs The State Of Bihar on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81593083/
